lines.2: 「Mm. Take care on your way home.」
lines.3: The director stood at the school gate, seeing the students off.
lines.4: He had the reassuring air of a father.
lines.5: 「June means the Sports and Martial Arts Festival is almost here.」
lines.7: 「Are you entering the combat tournament, Tsushima?」
lines.9: 「It's one of the festival's most popular events. You could be on television.」
lines.10: 「I don't exactly have a body built for fighting, do I?」
lines.11: 「I'll put my energy into betting on it instead.」
lines.12: 「Betting on the tournament is forbidden. Though telling people to obey that rule is probably hopeless.」
lines.13: 「Last year, Subaru lost to a taekwondo fighter, but that third-year has graduated. This year he'd better win and make me some money.」
lines.14: As we chatted about harmless school-event nonsense, we reached the fork where we would part.
lines.15: 「Well then, Tsushima. I go this way.」
lines.17: For some reason, I was reluctant to part.
lines.21: Yashi had left my mind in ruins, and now I felt completely soothed.
lines.26: Otome strode ahead, practically pulling me along behind her.
lines.27: She gave me a different kind of reassurance: the feeling that everything would be fine if I left it to her.
